stages.title: Foundation: API Frameworks & LLM Primitives
stages.focus: FastAPI, Pydantic, and Amazon Bedrock Converse API
tasks: Implement a typed REST endpoint using FastAPI and Pydantic validation
Configure AWS credentials and call Amazon Bedrock Claude 3.5 Sonnet
Handle rate limits, timeouts, and structured JSON output parsing
stages.checkpoint: Pass all automated API test cases with 100% coverage

stages.title: Decision Routing: Strands Decider 2B
stages.focus: System One wire protocol (/v1/systemone) and calibrated confidence
tasks: Study Strands Decider 2B architecture (torso + generic pointer head)
Build a choice question schema with criteria descriptions
stages.checkpoint: Benchmark routing latency vs full LLM invocations

stages.title: Orchestration & Interventions: Strands Agents SDK
stages.focus: Agent harness, tool registries, and InterventionHandler
tasks: Define typed agent tools using @tool decorator
Implement BeforeToolCall and AfterToolCall lifecycle hooks
Add guardrails to prevent unsafe or malformed tool invocations
stages.checkpoint: Agent autonomously routes and executes appropriate tools

stages.title: Frontend Experience: React & Vite Dashboard
stages.focus: React components, Tailwind CSS, and Lucide icons
tasks: Build responsive dark-mode dashboard with modern card hierarchy
Create interactive Decision Trace visualization panel
Implement Recharts radar and bar visualizers for skill metrics
stages.checkpoint: Zero console errors and clean mobile responsiveness

stages.title: Cloud Architecture & Containerization: Docker & AWS
stages.focus: Dockerfile, AWS App Runner, and ECS deployment patterns
tasks: Write multi-stage Dockerfiles for backend FastAPI and frontend Vite
Configure AWS IAM roles following least-privilege principles
Set up environment variables and health check probes
stages.checkpoint: Public health check returns 200 OK with live telemetry

stages.title: Portfolio Showcase & Interview Readiness
stages.focus: GitHub repository polish, video demo, and architecture documentation
tasks: Write professional README.md with architecture diagrams and setup guide
Record concise <3 min video walkthrough demonstrating decision flow
Draft AWS Builder Center article explaining reusable decision pattern
